doc.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011

title: Funk keys and Soulive's organ trio roots
summary: Soulive began as an organ trio; Lettuce balances guitar and horns.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Did you notice when you started transitioning into the funk world, especially with guitar player based bands, that you had to play in funkier keys?
Yeah, for the most part, yeah.
Of course Soulive is not a guitar — well

They are. I mean they started out as like an organ trio situation, like we listened to old Wes Montgomery type things, like and George Benson style things, or who else, Lou Donaldson type. It was definitely an organ trio you know. Let’s say Lettuce is like equally guitar and horn with the emphasis on the guitar and the horns.
